title: Kamahl Releases Mirari's Wake
summary: Kamahl abandons the Mirari sword in Krosa, releasing transformative magical energy into the forest.
narrative: After learning from the Krosan druids and turning away from his old life, Kamahl confronted the continuing danger of the Mirari and the ambitions of Laquatus.
He planted the Mirari sword in Krosa. The land absorbed and radiated its power, creating Mirari's Wake and changing the forest's fate.
